market_view: Money kept in the S&P 500 index fund; the daily Claude ideas are switched off.

plain_summary: Stocks are down on Fed rate-hike talk, but today's big drops come from real business problems, not overreactions, so we buy nothing and keep SPY.
Health insurers fell on a new Medicare rule that could cut their profits for years, and the other drops followed metal and oil prices, so we buy nothing this hour.
